body: Morpho Adds Loans Backed by Robinhood Tokenized Stocks, Opens Integration to External Apps

sourceReview.reason: Robinhood's July 1 product page confirms that Stock Tokens may be used as DeFi collateral and that Morpho powers a separate USDG lending product, but it does not document this Morpho market launch. The event-specific primary statements remain social posts; one report exposes only a loading shell and another is inaccessible, so the launch and external-app claim lack a readable primary source or two independent full-text reports.
